title: Courageous Entrepreneurs and Concentrated FinTech Investing
primary_theme: High-conviction FinTech investing as an emotional founder partnership
founder_lessons: Seek relational partners rather than transactional financiers when the startup journey is lonely.
Build a company so strong that other investors want in without coercion.
Avoid social-proof-driven fundraising dynamics that only reward consensus deals.
Concentration and conviction let investors see the company from the inside and support founders deeply.
notable_quotes: Investing in a startup is not like some kind of highly intellectualized, abstracted process.
They want relational partners who can help them build their business.
we are not, it's not a land of tremendous financial resources.
